visualCharacteristics.purpose: Teaser grid with a featured image card and text-only cards
visualCharacteristics.layout: Ruled grid, 3 columns from 960px: image cards span two rows, text cards stack two per column; sideways scrolling with arrows when the cards overflow
notable: Each card ends with a 'Lesen' arrow link
Prev / next arrows only when the grid overflows

contentPattern.structure: One row per card: optional picture, heading, teaser paragraph(s), a link paragraph

usage: Use for an overview of related topics where one teaser is featured with an image.
reuseGuidance: Fits 3-9 short teasers; use cards for uniform image cards and tiles for equal image tiles.
